description: Make the eBay DRAFT offers of up to 25 products LIVE and buyer-visible — a real publication on the seller's account. The item and offer are refreshed from the current product first, so a price, title, photo or characteristic fixed after the draft was made is published too. Pass only products whose nextAction from inspect_ebay_listings is publish_draft. Returns done, failed (with reasons) and notAttempted. Never tell the user a listing is live unless it is counted in done. Refused until the owner switches on AI publishing. The result echoes the workspace.

productIds.description: Make each product's eBay DRAFT offer LIVE and buyer-visible, at most 25 ids fetched with search_products. The item and offer are refreshed from current product data first, then published — this is a real, consequential publication, not a preview. Report every named per-product failure.

items.description: A product id returned by search_products.
